scope: Static repository/control audit plus deterministic Python, process and browser tests for the implemented ownership fix. No orders, live activation, broker campaign or claim of institutional equivalence.

reference.title: FINRA Regulatory Notice 15-09: Guidance on Effective Supervision and Control Practices for Firms Engaging in Algorithmic Trading Strategies
reference.use: Engineering comparison for risk assessment, development/change control, independent testing, trading supervision and monitoring. It is not an assertion that member-firm obligations apply to this retail deployment.

findings.observation: The original public node builder had no shared writer ownership; different IBKR client IDs could run separate risk books and write the same profile cache.
findings.disposition: Top implementation fixed locally; supported-broker validation remains pending. One slot spans all local accounts/profiles until account isolation is safe.

findings.observation: Trader IDs/cache namespaces are mode/profile-specific, and the saved strategy payload has no account identity. Renaming caches without migration could lose old allocation, halt and kill state.

Immediate operational persistence is applied to operator kills. Automatic risk kills rely on the shutdown snapshot. Universe mismatch can return before risk restoration; legacy allocation migration can omit old risk restoration.

findings.backlog: P0: Real-time risk emergency actuation follow-up
findings.observation: The independent supervisor queues commands for the same strategy process; it is not an independent broker cancel/flatten actuator if that process is stopped or dead.
CLI paper startup without --cash selects broker NAV, while the dashboard supplies an explicit allocation. The defaults do not provide one consistent capital contract.

Paper-soak runtime is first-to-last elapsed time rather than continuously observed time; health is calculated after trimming through the last unhealthy observation. Sparse observations and outages can overstate evidence.
Dedicated safety/recovery routes authenticate, but generic paper start/job cancellation do not share that contract. Remote authorization is already an open conditional deployment issue.

Registry artifacts and evaluations exist, but paper observations and campaign IDs are not bound to exact params, account/allocation and executing release. Registry evaluation consumes a caller-supplied ready report without that linkage.
Runtime broker/cache/ledger reconciliation is substantial; no independent statement/Flex cash, cost, position and PnL break-review workflow was found.
Offline model evaluation and drift comparisons are present, but no frozen independent signal/order-intent shadow execution workflow with an order-disabled boundary was found.

Purging, nested walk-forward and one-shot holdout controls are per study/campaign. No global experiment ledger links renamed campaigns, related hypotheses and reused inspected time windows or reports selection-adjusted uncertainty.
Local data snapshots and provenance exist, while declared vendor point-in-time availability, delisted coverage and historical universe membership remain incomplete/unknown.
Gross, symbol and reviewed sector rails are present. Industry-correlation alpha features do not supply covariance/factor or stressed liquidity/exit-cost portfolio risk budgets.

Current fill-price review references the strategy close, not the order's arrival NBBO. OHLC simulation and participation scenarios have not established observed transaction costs, capacity or independent fee reconciliation.
Python requirements are pinned and many local tests exist. The checked-in CI workflow only runs frontend tests/build/browser paths; a backend release/compatibility gate is absent.
Live freshness/revision controls largely share IBKR as their source. macOS clock synchronization is a manual warning, not measured offset/uncertainty evidence.

The pinned Nautilus risk engine already defaults to per-process submit/modify throttles; an explicit account/IBKR aggregate traffic contract with reserved emergency capacity was not found. This is a proposed refinement, not a claim of absent throttling.

Local hash-chained/trigger-protected audit records, alerts and encrypted recovery exist. Independent external anchoring, receipt/acknowledgement and clean-host/broker recovery evidence are not established; the off-host portion was previously deferred by the user.

implemented_top_fix.policy: One broker execution runner for the same local OS user and host, across all accounts, profiles, client IDs and persistence modes
implemented_top_fix.authority: Kernel flock held by a non-inheritable descriptor; no timeout, takeover endpoint or configurable alternate lock domain
implemented_top_fix.coverage: Public node builder before adapter/cache assembly, strategy startup, submissions/lists/modifications/cancellations/closes, risk supervision, resume and telemetry
implemented_top_fix.shutdown: Retained through node stop/dispose and explicit engine disconnection checks; unverified or failed disposal retains ownership; process death releases kernel ownership but does not assert broker flatness
implemented_top_fix.frontend: Paper/Live telemetry ownership review, CLI-owner instructions, explicit UNKNOWN/stale errors, owning-session stop and AVAILABLE-after-release review; launch conflict returns HTTP 409
implemented_top_fix.persistence: Existing trader IDs, strategy snapshots and risk/kill/allocation state are deliberately unchanged
scope_limitations: Not distributed or cross-user broker fencing; does not control manual/external IBKR clients
Stop old unguarded binaries before deployment; never unlink or replace the lock file
Account state isolation, automatic-kill recovery and independent emergency actuation remain open P0 work
Fresh broker reconciliation and every P0 capital gate remain required; live activation stays disabled

covered_faults: Concurrent account/client/profile attempts and no-persistence starts
Real child process SIGSTOP retention and SIGKILL lock release
Mutation attempts without ownership and after ownership loss
Build failure, sync/async run, stop, disposal exception and unverified disconnection
HTTP ownership review/unknown state and launch conflict before job creation
Dashboard owner stop preserves OWNED until release; CLI instructions, mobile layout and failed polling
verification.independent_review: No confirmed material lifecycle/safety defect within the local-user scope. Reviewer requested bounded/fresh ownership status; five-second request timeout, observation/receipt freshness expiry, single-flight polling and stalled/stale-request tests were added.
